lines.en: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
lines.zh: 什么是“甜如蜂蜜”以及为什么？

lines.en: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island,
lines.zh: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机坠毁在沃利斯岛，

lines.en: a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
lines.zh: 一个位于南太平洋的偏远地方，在萨摩亚以西很远。

lines.en: The plane wasn't too badly damaged,
lines.zh: 飞机没有损坏得太严重，

lines.en: but over the years the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
lines.zh: 但多年来，这次坠机事件被遗忘，残骸也一直未被触动。

lines.en: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
lines.zh: 1989年，坠机26年后，在一项对该岛的空中勘测中，这架飞机被意外重新发现。

lines.en: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
lines.zh: 此时，一架状况尚可的兰开斯特轰炸机已属罕见，值得营救。

lines.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
lines.zh: 法国当局将飞机打包，并分批运回法国。

lines.en: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
lines.zh: 现在，一群爱好者正准备修复这架飞机。

lines.en: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
lines.zh: 它有四台劳斯莱斯梅林发动机，但该团队只需要重建其中三台。

lines.en: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases
lines.zh: 想象一下，当他们打开包装箱时，是多么惊喜和高兴，

lines.en: and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
lines.zh: 发现第四台发动机“甜如蜂蜜”——仍然处于完美状态。

lines.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
lines.zh: 一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了一个蜂巢，它完全被蜂蜡保存了下来！
